_comment: Seed manifest for the linkace held-out suite target (plan-005 U1, R1). Seeding is API-driven: the generic harness POSTs each entry to /api/v1/links with a headlessly-minted Bearer token. All cached target-side evidence and the LINKACE_SLICE reference verdicts are defined against THIS post-seed state — changing it is a deliberate, recorded apparatus migration, not an edit. URLs are never fetched, so they only need to be unique and stable. The titles match the LINKACE_SLICE scenarios (suite.py).
